decisions.text: No WebView anywhere: react-native-webview is never a dependency (not even transitive) and no core flow shows web content. 'Create an account in Studio' and links to Studio open the system browser.
Sign-in only, with Clerk email code, password and passkey. No sign-up in the app, no social logins, no Sign in with Apple: no expo-apple-authentication, no useSSO, no oauth_* strategies.

Sign-in is pluggable: src/auth/providers/ holds one file per provider behind a small AuthProvider interface (kind, getToken(), signOut(), onExpired()); clerk.ts in this wave, device.ts (US-006) and oidc.ts (PRD-257) later as added files, not rewrites. The discovery document's auth.modes picks the provider; an unknown mode shows 'This server needs a newer Automatos Go'.

All HTTP goes through src/api/ (an ESLint rule forbids fetch and XMLHttpRequest anywhere else); streaming goes through src/api/stream.ts on expo/fetch. Every call sends Authorization: Bearer <token> and X-Workspace-ID; the workspace id is read back from GET /api/workspaces/current on every launch because the server silently replaces a header the user can no longer use.
Every API response, the discovery document and every notification payload is parsed with zod before use; unknown frames and fields are ignored and never crash.
Feature folders, small files: 200-400 lines target, never over 800; functions under 50 lines, components under 150, nesting under 4. The lint config enforces the limits.
Pure logic outside React: reducers, parsers, token maths and policy live in plain TypeScript with vitest tests beside them (__tests__/); screens and hooks only wire them.
src/core/web/** is copied from automatos-ai by scripts/sync-core.ts at a pinned SHA recorded in core.lock.json and is never edited by hand; CI fails on any drift from the lock.
State updates return new objects; no mutation of props, query data or arguments.
URLs, keys and tunables come from the EAS environment (EXPO_PUBLIC_* at build time) or the discovery document; tunables are named constants; copy lives in one strings module per feature.

Errors are never swallowed: each failure maps to the error taxonomy (network, auth, forbidden, server, stream, plus not_found/conflict/invalid_response) and a user-facing message that leaks no internals.

Styles are data: a layout reads tokens only, never literal colours (a lint rule bans colour literals outside src/styles/tokens/ and the vendored core). Three styles (Studio, Play, HUD) will share the Command Centre screens and differ by tokens and layout components, not by copies of screens; this wave builds Studio's tokens and Light/Dark/System only (styles are wave A5).

The AI label ('Auto is an AI' / '{agent} is an AI') sits by the composer on every chat screen and on the voice screen, in FIXED colours no look or theme can change; the composer is disabled while the label is not on screen.
Apache-2.0 (LICENSE, full text).

Name 'Automatos Go', bundle id and Android package com.automatos.app, scheme automatos, iPhone only (supportsTablet false), 16+ in the store metadata, 11 pt minimum text, Dynamic Type with layouts that wrap.
runtimeVersion: { policy: 'fingerprint' }, not appVersion.
Every native module goes into this wave's build (the EAS free tier's 15 iOS builds a month are shared with the academy app); later waves add no native module, config plugin or app.json change.
Nothing about plans, credits or prices anywhere in the app. A paused workspace says 'Your workspace is paused; ask your workspace owner'.
The app deletes nothing: no account or workspace deletion.
Owners, admins and editors answer and approve; viewers get a read-only app ('Ask your workspace owner for editor access to talk to Auto').

Features are gated on the discovery document's capabilities, never on a server version: no push → no push settings; no spoken_mode → quick-ask reads plain text; no voice_live → no Live button; no mobile_theme → built-in styles only.
TanStack Query with the web's key families; the cache persists in encrypted MMKV; chat message bodies and question text are never persisted; writes (answer, approve, pause) are never queued offline.

No EAS init, no credentials, no secrets in this repository: the EAS projectId, the App Store Connect record and EXPO_TOKEN are human steps (ownerTest). The scaffold works without them: testflight.yml fails fast with a clear message when EXPO_TOKEN or the projectId is missing. The Clerk publishable key comes only from EAS env / EXPO_PUBLIC_* at build time.

acceptanceCriteria: src/api/live.ts: LiveEvents keeps ONE GET /api/v1/tasks/stream connection while the app is foregrounded (AppState) and signed in, through src/api/sse.ts; reconnects with backoff 1 s → 30 s (named constants); on resume refetches (the stream has no replay); board_changed invalidates the board, ticket, needsYou and questions families; chat_changed is emitted to subscribers; useLiveEvent(type, handler) and useLiveStatus() ('live' | 'connecting' | 'offline') for the header's STREAMING LIVE; frames parsed with zod, unknown events ignored

src/api/needs-you.ts: GET /api/activity/needs-you parsed with zod ({total, counts {review, question, approval, stuck, failed}, rows {…}} per digests/command-centre-api.md), useNeedsYou() → {total, rows}

src/ui/CommandCentreButton.tsx: the header button (layout-dashboard icon, 'Command Centre', the CountBadge with useNeedsYou().total) that navigates to routes.cc.board — the ONE place the number is rendered in the header
Tests: the reconnect/backoff scheduler, the event → invalidation map, chat_changed fan-out, needs-you parsing with unknown fields

userStories.notes: Server facts (digests/command-centre-api.md): on connect the stream sends event board_changed {workspace_id}; pg_notify frames board_changed {workspace_id, task_id, status, event} and chat_changed {workspace_id, chat_id, user_id, event}; ': hb' every 20 s; no Last-Event-ID replay; it needs the Authorization header, so it is read with fetch, not EventSource.
